units.title: The actual first-column law
units.reader_note: The column law and integral transport are proved; canonical surface identification and Poisson evaluation remain open.
units.statement: Move the selected Gaussian expectation to the actual Euclidean first-column distribution, preserving probability, sphere support and full orthogonal invariance.
assumptions: Exactly \(n\in\mathbb N,\ n\ge3\) and \(\kappa\in\mathbb R,\ \kappa\ge4\), including \(\kappa=4\). All parameter divisions are real, and \(n/2\) is a real exponent even for odd dimensions.
\(\mu\) is the existing actual normalized Haar probability on full \(O(n)\), including reflections. \(c(O)=Oe_1\) uses the Euclidean l2 norm, and \(\nu=c_*\mu\) is its literal ambient pushforward.

Probability, unit-sphere support, invariance and absolute L1 are proved conclusions. The quotient need not be continuous or have positive denominator off the support; global Borel measurability suffices for transport. No sphere law or Poisson identity is a caller premise.

notation.text: The identical source-selected parameters and coefficient, with real dimension arithmetic.
Index zero in Fin n is the source first coordinate. The measure is an actual pushforward; standard surface-measure equality is still open.
Literal source precision and the actual canonical Gaussian expectation. The rotation in the conclusion is the ordinary Euclidean matrix action.

steps.title: Use the actual column pushforward
steps.text: Each matrix entry varies continuously with O. The Euclidean identification preserves this continuity, so the column map is measurable and pushes the existing full-Haar probability to a probability.
steps.lean: hc uses PiLp.continuous_toLp and continuous matrix entries. hprob consumes the identical OrthogonalHaar.orthogonalHaar_spec and canonical Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map.

steps.title: Prove genuine Euclidean sphere support
steps.text: Transport the orthogonal matrix through the canonical star-algebra equivalence to Euclidean continuous linear maps. Its unitary norm-preservation acts on the first unit basis vector. The resulting column has norm one for every O, hence also almost surely under its pushforward.
steps.lean: hnorm calls Unitary.map_mem and ContinuousLinearMap.norm_map_of_mem_unitary on Matrix.toEuclideanCLM, then Matrix.mulVec_single_one and PiLp.norm_single. hsphere applies ae_map_iff to the measurable norm level set. No l-infinity norm proxy is used.

steps.title: Preserve the full orthogonal action
steps.text: The actual matrix action commutes with taking the first column by left multiplication. Full Haar invariance, including reflections, therefore gives invariance of the literal column law. This alone is not an identification with canonical surface measure.
steps.lean: hinvariant proves the exact equivariance identity, reuses Measure.map_map twice and calls the identical compiled OrthogonalHaar.orthogonalHaar_map_mul_left. Q is an arbitrary element of full O(n), not SO(n).

steps.title: Transport absolute integrability on the actual support
steps.text: The normalized scalar Haar kernel is exactly f composed with c. Its existing absolute integrability transfers through the measurable pushforward. The ambient quotient is Borel measurable; no off-sphere positivity or continuity is asserted.
steps.lean: hf is global Borel measurability of the literal totalized real quotient. hp consumes the identical PoissonNormalization.selected_gaussian_normalization; hL uses integrable_map_measure with its actual L1 conclusion and the proved measurable c. Positivity and the chosen tilt are supplied by the existing producer, never extra hypotheses.

steps.title: Keep the actual Gaussian expectation attached
steps.text: Use change of variables for the same absolutely integrable function. Substitute the transported integral into the existing selected Gaussian normalization. The focused consumer performs the same substitution in the actual determinant-conditioned Gaussian bind-mixture expectation gap, retaining its factor two.
steps.lean: The final equality directly uses integral_map and hp.2. Tests.GaussianComplexityColumnTransport composes this exact declaration with MixtureExpectation.actual_mixture_expectation_gap; neither a canonical sphere law nor a Poisson value is assumed.

units.lean_statement: Exact preproof signature: only source n>=3 and kappa>=4; actual column law and every analytic side condition are outputs.
units.lean_proof: Canonical unitary norm preservation, literal equivariance, full-Haar invariance and measurable integral transport join the existing actual Gaussian normalization.
units.boundary: Probability, unit-sphere support, full orthogonal invariance of the actual first-column law and transport of the existing actual signed Gaussian expectation to an absolutely integrable ambient first-column kernel. Canonical normalized surface measure identification/uniqueness and Poisson evaluations remain OPEN; no Eq24 value, positive TV ratio, query/cost, hidden-eigenbasis or main theorem.
